Jethalal mistake-prone day continues at Gada Electronics when a customer named Vishwajit turns out to only want 200 ml of black paint for his cycle—costing Jethalal an actual mobile and LCD TV sale plus ₹150 for cold coffee.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
